decisions.reason: Superyacht crew recruitment builds on the firm's seafarer network and crewing centres and was already reaffirmed in 2024, so the firm stays committed despite limited visible results.
The BSM Smart Academy was publicly launched with a growing network of partner institutions and is central to the training and integrated-solutions direction, so it will be kept.
FuelEU monitoring and compliance services are driven by regulation, were delivered successfully before the deadline, and are core to the environmental-performance direction.
The FuelEU Dashboard is fully integrated into the PAL software, so the firm's investment and public commitment to digital compliance tools make it likely to be kept.
The FuelEU cost simulator is integrated into PAL and supports the announced digital and environmental direction, so the firm will keep it even if early uptake is modest.
